scope_notes: Matching-layer dictionary for mapping registry energy variables (dataset abscissa) to the toy frequency variable omega used by scattering toy carriers.
This file is intentionally conservative: if a dataset mapping is missing or marked as incomplete, it must NOT be used for cross-dataset CAP selection.
Default policy (M1): only the proxy_E benchmark is eligible for CAP anchoring; MeV datasets remain audit-only within-dataset.
To enable M2, provide explicit mapping entries with a declared model and parameters; the audit script will report coverage and exclusions.

breit_wigner_single_resonance_demo.note: Synthetic benchmark: omega = E, gamma_omega = gamma_E.

hepdata_pipi_delta00_mukhin_et_al_v1_tab.note: Match convention (M2): omega := omega_center + (E - E0)/gamma, gamma_omega := 1. Uses registry-provided (E0,gamma) only.

said_pin_p33_wi08_wcm_1100to1350_step5.note: Match convention (M2): omega := omega_center + (E - E0)/gamma_mid, gamma_omega := 1, where gamma_mid := (gamma_low+gamma_high)/2 if the registry provides a band.

nn_online_np_1S0_pwa93_0to50MeV_step5.note: T_lab requires a kinematic map to CM energy; keep audit-only unless completed.

nn_online_np_3S1_pwa93_0to50MeV_step5.note: T_lab requires a kinematic map to CM energy; keep audit-only unless completed.
